summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to fully integrate Nemo Chemistry Tutor into ChemPYQ Studio as a unified, synchronized web application. Replaces the standalone iframe with native React panels for Nemo Chat, Reaction Canvas, and Study Analytics; ports Nemo's signature CSS animations, vibrating haptics, shake on wrong answer, and neon-green correct pulse; introduces an interactive floating Nemo mascot with real-time reactive expressions; and unifies visual styles and navigation across all views.
